title: 2023 AMC 12A Problem 3
statement: How many positive perfect squares less than \(2023\) are divisible by \(5?\)

solutions.text:
A perfect square is divisible by \(5\) only if its root is, so the squares are \((5k)^2=25k^2.\)

Since \(44^2=1936\lt 2023\) \(\lt 2025=45^2,\) the root can be \(5,10,\ldots,40,\) which is \(k=1\) through \(8.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: A perfect square is divisible by \(5\) exactly when its root is a multiple of \(5\)
The squares are \((5k)^2\); find how many satisfy \((5k)^2\lt 2023\)
